speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our assessment of your acute diarrhea, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any blood or mucus in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-Associated Diarrhea (likely *Clostridioides difficile* infection).

Given your recent treatment with levofloxacin for pneumonia, combined with the onset of severe watery diarrhea and abdominal cramping, this is highly suggestive of *C. diff*. I will immediately request a stool test to confirm this.
REQUEST TEST: Stool_Oxidase, Stool_Cultures, Stool_Ova_and_Parasites, Stool_Cytology, Stool_Florence
